setlist.title: Untitled (I Might Compare) - this is a lyric from the Sweden era which JD dug up for that silent film score he did in 2010. other than that this is the only other recording of it I'm aware of. we still don't know its real title, if it had one
Birthday Song (This TIme Has Gone) - unreleased track played from the mid 90s to 2000ish mostly
My Favorite Things - probably the most well-known song on here, which is a wild thing to say. it's on a lot of bootlegs. I love John Coltrane!

Pure Change - that's what JD introduces it as but I always knew it as Pure Sun because of the one other recording. Song played once in like 1994 and then sometime last decade there was a show where he tried to remember it and only got through the first verse
Real Good Girlfriend - very cute song played once in Belgium about a month after this and then as far as I know never again. this recording is so amazing, gotta be my highlight
Are Friends Electric? (Gary Numan cover, two takes)

liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Untitled (I Might Compare) - this is a lyric from the Sweden era which JD dug up for that silent film score he did in 2010. other than that this is the only other recording of it I'm aware of. we still don't know its real title, if it had one**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Birthday Song (This TIme Has Gone) - unreleased track played from the mid 90s to 2000ish mostly**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **My Favorite Things - probably the most well-known song on here, which is a wild thing to say. it's on a lot of bootlegs. I love John Coltrane!**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 13 archived performances [2]
- **Pure Change - that's what JD introduces it as but I always knew it as Pure Sun because of the one other recording. Song played once in like 1994 and then sometime last decade there was a show where he tried to remember it and only got through the first verse**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Real Good Girlfriend - very cute song played once in Belgium about a month after this and then as far as I know never again. this recording is so amazing, gotta be my highlight**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Are Friends Electric? (Gary Numan cover, two takes)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]

## The recordings

- **tmg1996-02-26** (recommended): source not stated; 6 songs; 24 min [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **tmg1996-02-26**: taped by Gregor Kessler; transferred by notasfarwest; source: High Bias Tape [1]
